messages:
Aria: Quick async — short status check on the kernel + KV milestone. Need clear owners, outstanding PRs, and any blockers before EOD. TL;DR: target merge for kv-prefetch v2, continuous-batching gating, and perf regression checklist.

Ben: I opened the kv-prefetch v2 PR: https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/432 — waiting on @Sanjay and @Lila for review. Local perf tests look good but one e2e in canary is failing.

Sanjay: Looking now. The e2e failure looks flaky; logs point to a KV miss on long-context runs. Adding a debug flag to reproduce.

Lila: I can take the review tonight. Anything specific I should focus on — correctness or perf?

Ben: Focus on cache handshake and a possible race during warmup. Also double-check the eviction tweak we introduced.

Maria: Reminder — Dedicated rollout is scheduled Mon. If this PR slips, canary->prod moves. Do we have a plan B/fallback?

Aria: Plan B = runtime toggle to fall back to the previous kv-shim. I can add the toggle; prefer keeping the canary live if fixes land.

Ben: WIP: added runtime toggle. Example control call: PATCH /api/v1/runtime/config {"kv_prefetch_v2": false} — will push the toggle in ~10m.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary deployment started for kv-prefetch-v2 on cluster-canary-7.

Sanjay: Running perf harness now: `./tools/perf_run --suite=kv-warmup --target=canary-7` — will post results in ~15m.

Lila: Review done. Left 2 tiny nits and 1 substantive comment about atomic swap logic for the cache pointer. @Ben can you address?

Ben: Addressed the atomic-swap comment and pushed fixes + tests. PR now has updated tests and a short runbook snippet.

Aria: Two quick asks before we close: 1) expand the runbook with the warmup edge-case steps; 2) ping infra for a small memory bump on canary-7 while we validate.

Ben: Added runbook snippet in the PR description. Pinged infra (Simon) for the memory bump.

Simon: On it — increasing canary-7 memory by ~12% for the next deploy window.

Maria: If all canary checks pass, we schedule the canary->prod toggle and I'll coordinate CS/Support messaging.

Aria: Good. Owners and final checks by EOD (timezone note): otherwise we'll enable the fallback toggle tomorrow AM.

Ben: Ownership: Ben (PR/merge), Sanjay (perf harness + e2e), Lila (code review). Plan to complete by EOD.

Lila: :thumbsup:
